caption: The top call selects Pen, Book, Bag; .addClass('sel') returns the same three, so .first() narrows the set to Pen before .text('Pen (new)') changes it. The separate arrow marks the .each() loop, which prints Pen (new), Book, Bag.

spec.title: One chain, then each loop
spec.aria: A jQuery selection of three list items, Pen, Book and Bag, gets class sel on all three, then first() keeps only Pen and text() changes it to Pen (new); a separate new-select arrow leads to each(), whose console output is Pen (new), Book, Bag.
